_comment: The canonical verdict: one complete example of the shape docs/gate/verdict.md
describes and @cujo/gate-contract types, carrying every field at once.
A fail with three findings: one proven and blocking (a test that passes on
base and fails on head), one judged and advisory (the judge read something),
and one that needs a human (a sensor never armed, so nothing was observed).
The summary counts are the findings; packages/gate-contract/tests asserts it.
The verdict is a pure function of `binding`. Nothing here was reported by

plugins.note: The decoy sensor did not arm; decoy reads were not observed.

findings.message: `round_total` now rounds half up; its docstring says half to even.

evidence.excerpt:

evidence.rationale: The implementation and the docstring disagree on the tie rule.

findings.title: The decoy sensor did not arm
findings.message: Reads of the decoy secret were not observed on this run. A clean decoy result here says nothing.
